Title: Karan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Karan - 29 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Vikram - 60 years, king, father
Look: golden crown, red royal robe

Places

1. The battlefield - tents, flags, dust
2. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
3. The fields - a wheat crop, a neem tree

Scene 1: The battlefield - Day

[Karan stands on the battlefield. Vikram stands near him.]

Karan: "Let's do something fun today."

[Karan draws his sword and charges.]

Vikram: "That's easy."

[Karan blocks the blow with his shield.]

Vikram: "Well done!"

[Karan mounts his horse and rides into battle.]

Vikram: "Yes, all right."

[Karan salutes the general.]

Karan: "And then?"

Scene 2: The kitchen - Day

Karan: "What a nice place."

[Karan cuts his finger while chopping onions and it starts to bleed.]

Vikram: "Karan, are you okay?"

[The knife slips and Karan's hand is cut; blood drips onto the floor.]

Vikram: "And then?"

[Karan winces as blood trickles from the cut on his thumb.]

Karan: "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 3: The fields - Day

[Karan stands in the fields. Vikram stands near him.]

Vikram: "What a nice place."

[A cobra bites Karan and he dies in the fields.]

Vikram (laughing): "No… this cannot be!"
